run_count_docs: run the script to count documents and average lines and tokens per document in a text file
run_count_docs_gzip: run the script with the --gzip flag to count documents in a gzip compressed file
review_main: review the main function that parses arguments and iterates over lines to count documents
summarize_gopen: summarize the gopen helper function that opens either gzip or plain text files for reading
test_count_docs: test the count_docs script by providing a sample text file with documents separated by empty lines
